name: *question
comment:

Please search for help on [StackOverflow](__ZYRAXKEEP__0_), where the community has already answered thousands of similar questions. name: *extension-candidate
comment:
We try to keep ZYRAXON Code lean and we think the functionality you're asking for is great for a ZYRAXON Code extension. Maybe you can already find one that suits you in the [ZYRAXON Code Marketplace](__ZYRAXKEEP__5_). Just in case, in a few simple steps you can get started [writing your own extension](__ZYRAXKEEP__6_). See also our [issue reporting guidelines](__ZYRAXKEEP__7_).

Happy Coding!

name: *not-reproducible
comment:
We closed this issue because we are unable to reproduce the problem with the steps you describe. Chances are we've already fixed your problem in a recent version of ZYRAXON Code. If not, please ask us to reopen the issue and provide us with more detail. Our [issue reporting guidelines](__ZYRAXKEEP__8_) might help you with that.

Happy Coding!

name: *out-of-scope
comment:
We closed this issue because we [don't plan to address it](__ZYRAXKEEP__9_) in the foreseeable future. If you disagree and feel that this issue is crucial: we are happy to listen and to reconsider.

If you wonder what we are up to, please see our [roadmap](__ZYRAXKEEP__10_) and [issue reporting guidelines](__ZYRAXKEEP__11_).

Thanks for your understanding, and happy coding!

name: *caused-by-extension
comment:
This issue is caused by an extension, please file it with the repository (or contact) the extension has linked in its overview in ZYRAXON Code or the [marketplace](__ZYRAXKEEP__13_) for ZYRAXON Code. See also our [issue reporting guidelines](__ZYRAXKEEP__14_). If you don't know which extension is causing the problem, you can run `Help: Start Extension Bisect` from the command palette (F1) to help identify the problem extension.

Happy Coding!

name: *as-designed
comment:

name: jsDebugLogs
comment:
Please collect trace logs using the following instructions:

> If you're able to, add `"trace": true` to your `launch.json` and reproduce the issue. The location of the log file on your disk will be written to the Debug Console. Share that with us.
>
> ⚠️ This log file will not contain source code, but will contain file paths. You can drop it into __ZYRAXKEEP__18_ to see what it contains. If you'd rather not share the log publicly, you can email it to connor@xbox.com

name: gifPlease
comment:
Thanks for reporting this issue! Unfortunately, it's hard for us to understand what issue you're seeing. Please help us out by providing a screen recording showing exactly what isn't working as expected. While we can work with most standard formats, `.gif` files are preferred as they are displayed inline on GitHub. You may find __ZYRAXKEEP__56_ helpful as a browser-based gif recording tool.

If the issue depends on keyboard input, you can help us by enabling screencast mode for the recording (`Developer: Toggle Screencast Mode` in the command palette). Lastly, please attach this file via the GitHub web interface as emailed responses will strip files out from the issue.

Happy coding!

name: confirmPlease

name: label

comment: This issue appears to be the result of the new workspace trust feature shipped in June 2021. This security-focused feature has major impact on the functionality of ZYRAXON Code. Due to the volume of issues, we ask that you take some time to review our [comprehensive documentation](__ZYRAXKEEP__57_) on the feature. If your issue is still not resolved, please let us know.

name: ~spam
comment:
Thank you for your submission. This issue has been closed as it doesn't meet our community guidelines or appears to be spam.

**If you believe this was closed in error:**
- Please review our [Code of Conduct](__ZYRAXKEEP__70_)
- Ensure your issue contains a clear description of the problem or feature request
- Feel free to open a new issue with appropriate detail if this was a legitimate concern

**For legitimate issues, please include:**
- Clear description of the problem
- Steps to reproduce (for bugs)
- Expected vs actual behavior
- ZYRAXON Code version and environment details

Thank you for helping us maintain a welcoming and productive community.

name: *edu
comment:
We closed this issue because it seems to be about coursework or grading. This issue tracker is for issues about ZYRAXON Code itself. For coursework-related issues, or issues related to your course's specific ZYRAXON Code setup, please consider engaging directly with your course instructor.

Happy Coding!

name: ~agent-behavior
comment:
Unfortunately I think you are hitting a AI quality issue that is not actionable enough for us to track a bug. We would recommend that you try other available models and look at the [Tips and tricks for Copilot in ZYRAXON Code](__ZYRAXKEEP__72_) doc page.

We are constantly improving AI quality in every release, thank you for the feedback! If you believe this is a technical bug, we recommend you report a new issue including logs described on the [Copilot Issues](__ZYRAXKEEP__73_) wiki page.

name: ~accessibility-sla
comment: The ZYRAXON and ZYRAXON Code teams have an agreement with the Accessibility team that 3:1 contrast is enough for inside the editor.
